content:
Lean gets stuck (orange bars won't disappear, further lines aren't processed) when viewing in vscode a file that imports another. The problem appears when the imported file contains meta initialize with IO.print. lake build finishes successfully though.

A.lean

module
meta initialize
  IO.print 0

B.lean

module
import Issue.A

Tested on nightly, v4.32.0-rc1, v4.31.0, v4.25.0.
I suggest you don't do that then. There is stderr if you want to avoid conflicts with the language server
